rule: R-C6-7: higher axis-4, tie → higher axis sum, tie → r1; axis-4 < 4 or back_details_wrong → FLAGGED

SW.axis4_reason: The horn and tome are near, the blade is far, both hands grip the diagonal front-crossing haft, and the face is appropriately visible.

W.axis4_reason: Near horn and book, two separated shaft grips, a far-side blade and visible level profile preserve anatomical sides; deduct one because the crescent remains broadly face-on instead of convincingly foreshortened.

NW.axis4_reason: Near left horn and tome, far screen-right blade, visible back-crossing haft and two grips fit NW; the tiny cheek edge is expressly permitted.

N.axis4_reason: Blade, horn, tome, rear face visibility and the two grips are correct; deduct one for the central haft being occluded by the back rather than visibly running behind the character across it.

NE.axis4_reason: Near right blade, far left horn, grips and hidden face fit NE; deduct one because the far-hip tome remains substantially exposed instead of mostly hidden.

E.axis4_reason: Near blade, far horn, hidden tome, front-crossing two-handed haft and visible profile are correct; deduct one for the broad face-on blade plane rather than the requested edge-on or only slightly turned crescent.

SE.axis4_reason: Both gauntlets grip the front-crossing shaft, the blade is over the near screen-left right shoulder, horn and partly occluded book remain far on screen-right, and the visible face has no anatomical side reversal.
